title: Crestline Advance Seat Fee Schedule by Fare Brand
content:
**Ancillary fee schedule — advance seats on Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** Seat prices are per passenger per flight segment, in US dollars. A segment of 1000 statute miles or less is a short segment; a segment longer than 1000 miles is a long segment.

## Seat entitlement of each fare brand

| Fare brand | Advance seat entitlement |
|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | Paid only: every advance seat is purchased; a standard seat is otherwise assigned free at check-in |
| Crestline Main Cabin | Standard seats included; preferred and extra-legroom seats purchased |
| Crestline Main Plus | Extra-legroom seats included; preferred and extra-legroom seats free |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Standard seats included; preferred and extra-legroom seats purchased |
| Crestline Premium Economy | Premium cabin included; no main-cabin seat fee applies |
| Crestline First | Premium cabin included; no main-cabin seat fee applies |

## Seat prices

| Fare brand | Segment length threshold (miles) | Standard, short | Standard, long | Preferred, short | Preferred, long | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat, short | Extra-legroom Main Plus seat, long |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 1000 | 15 | 25 | 24 | 39 | 49 | 89 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 24 | 39 | 49 | 89 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 24 | 39 | 49 | 89 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline First | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The threshold is inclusive: a segment of exactly 1000 miles takes the short-segment price, and a segment of 1001 miles takes the long-segment price.
2. A price of 0 corresponds to a seat the fare brand includes.
3. Hypothetical illustration: a preferred seat on a 1,450-mile segment of a Crestline Main Cabin ticket is listed at 39 dollars; the same seat on a 900-mile segment is listed at 24 dollars.
